description: This header file declares functions related to WebPA notification handling, including configurations and retrieval of notification source and parameter list.

methods.name: setNotifyConfigurationFile
methods.description: Initializes WebPA notification configuration file with the specified filename.

methods.name: getnotifyparamList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of WebPA notification parameters and their count.

methods.name: getNotifySource
methods.description: Returns the source of WebPA notifications.
